annotations.title: Get Australian student visa grant rates

description: Query published Australian student visa grant and refusal decisions (BP0015) with optional filters, monthly results and a breakdown. Results include the official source, period, snapshot and sample notices. Grant rates describe historical decision groups. This public endpoint returns English natural-language text, preserving sources, conditions and pagination.

age.description: Age group as reported in the source dataset.

breakdown_by.description: Optional grouping dimension. The total and monthly series still use all requested filters.

country.description: Country of citizenship. Use an official name, a Chinese or English alias, or an ISO3 code.

fy.description: Starting year of the Australian financial year. For example, 2025 means July 2025 to June 2026. Use fy or months.

location.description: Applicant location, In Australia or Outside Australia.

months.description: Number of months ending at the snapshot’s latest decision month. Defaults to 12 when fy is absent.

sector.description: Education sector, such as Higher Education Sector or higher-education.

snapshotId.description: Optional previously published snapshot ID. Omit for the current snapshot.

state.description: Education provider’s registered state or territory.

name: get_student_visa_grant_rates
title: Get Australian student visa grant rates
